assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow to identify unmet product-specification requirements from implementation evidence and return requirement-traceable feature issues with testable acceptance criteria.
assessments.rationale: The source directs review of supplied agreements and contract risk; it provides no process to compare product requirements with implementation evidence or return feature issues.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Comparison of specification requirements with implementation evidence to identify each unmet requirement and provide its testable acceptance criteria.
assessments.rationale: The source creates issues by implementation-plan phase and checks existing issues, but does not compare specification requirements with implementation evidence or require an issue and acceptance criteria for each unmet requirement.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Creation of requirement-traceable feature issues from a comparison of product specifications and implementation evidence.
assessments.rationale: The source delivers a text user-flow map covering branches, errors, and risks, not a comparison of specification requirements with implementation evidence or an issue set.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Identification of every unmet requirement from implementation evidence, with a separate requirement-traceable issue and testable acceptance criteria for each.
assessments.rationale: The source creates one issue for a complete specification and checks existing issues, but does not assess implementation evidence or produce an issue for every unmet requirement with acceptance criteria.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Comparison of product specifications with implementation evidence and creation of feature issues for unmet requirements.
assessments.rationale: The source structures customer-facing marketing messaging around narrative elements; it contains no workflow for implementation-evidence comparison or feature-issue creation.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Comparison of product specifications with implementation evidence and creation of requirement-traceable feature issues for unmet requirements.
assessments.rationale: The source creates repository community files and GitHub templates, but does not compare specification requirements with implementation evidence or create the requested issue set.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Comparison of product specifications with implementation evidence and creation of feature issues for unmet requirements.
assessments.rationale: The source surveys documented UI conventions and produces research artifacts; it does not evaluate implementation evidence against product requirements or create issues.
The source extracts specification requirements, checks implementation status, creates one issue per unimplemented requirement, and requires requirement mapping and acceptance criteria.
